mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL (Consumer Price Index) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0% per annum, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.2% increase in 1 month) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 205) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL > 205
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL > 205.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400 thousand units, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 1 month) and unemployment (UNRATE) is below 4.5%, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are positive.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 1 month AND UNRATE < 4.5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 1 month AND UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 110 (index 2017=100), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5.0% per annum, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days are negative.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.
